headline: Google has put its new Gemini 4 Argon model and a background tasks mode into the Gemini app, but only for paying AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.
score_reason: Pool score kept: Google moves its newest model and a task-running agent into a widely used consumer app, but only for paying tiers and with no measurements or limits published.
importance_line: Paying Gemini users, on plans that PPC Land puts at $19.99 a month and up, get the newest model and a mode that works in the background with partners such as Instacart and Shopify, while free and cheaper-plan users are not mentioned and Google gives no benchmarks, usage limits, country list or privacy details.
summary: PPC Land reports, from Google's announcement of 13 Oct 2026, that Gemini 4 Argon, Google's newest reasoning model, is now in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, with a switch from chat to a tasks mode that Google says keeps working when the user is away from the computer, and that Gemini now connects to more than 40 apps. PPC Land adds that the post gives no benchmarks, usage limits, prices or country list, so Google's claims that Argon answers more directly and codes better are not measured.
notes: Read in full on PPC Land, which summarises Google's own blog post (the only official text, according to PPC Land). Plan prices come from PPC Land's earlier reporting of Google documentation. Model release itself is category 01 (C01-01).
